title: Zikr in the dars
summary: The remembrance practices Hazrat speaks of: beginning with the verse that commands it, the pact of yaad-faramosh, and the adhkar of the Divine Names. Purpose and outline only.

blocks.p: 'In zikr one draws closer to Allah,' Hazrat says in the dars on Bai'at; 'one remembers Allah, and the thought stays turned towards Allah.' He also warns that listening to qawwali all night is not enough on its own.
In part 3 Hazrat teaches that a deed done under Allah's command enters Qurb-e-Faraiz, nearness through the obligatory. So before a deed, recall the verse that commands it.

blocks.q: When we want to do the dhikr of the Kalima, La ilaha illa Allah, we first read Fa'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allah: know that there is no god but Allah.

blocks.p: In the same way, before durood sharif he reads the verse Innallaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'ala-n-Nabi, because it carries a command: 'O you who believe, send blessings upon him.'

Hazrat describes a pact made among companions so that the remembrance of Allah never breaks. They would sit, talk and work together; one would call out 'Allah!' Whoever's heart was present answered 'Alhamdulillah'; whoever had become heedless answered 'Astaghfirullah'.

blocks.q: Through this pact of yaad-faramosh, not only does one get help toward constant presence; one also has to admit one's own mistake, and your work becomes lillah, fillah.

blocks.p: In part 9 the book names adhkar that help the thought settle: Ya 'Aleemu, Ya Khabeeru, Ya Samee'u, Ya Baseeru. With each, attention is turned to a place, and each has a stated purpose: Ya 'Aleemu toward the umm-ud-dimagh, 'the centre of knowledge'; Ya Khabeeru toward the heart, 'so that you become aware'; Ya Samee'u toward the ears, so that the hearing becomes strong; Ya Baseeru toward the eyes, 'you will see what you did not see until now'.

Hazrat tells how, reciting these Names while riding his cycle on the road from Yakutpura, 'aalam-e-misaal opened before him. He adds that becoming aware of people's thoughts and seeing far-off things are 'matters of a low degree'.

blocks.q: Your work is only to recite. To give it effect, to complete it, is the work of Allah. You do your work.

blocks.note: Parts 6 to 9 are not yet public on YouTube, so those passages have no video link yet. This article gives no counts, times or manner for these adhkar: ask your teacher.
Learn this practice from your teacher before doing it.

by: Draft prepared from the dars transcripts, awaiting teacher approval

ru.title: Dars mein zikr
ru.summary: Zikr ke woh amal jinka Hazrat zikr karte hain: hukm wali aayat se shuruaat, yaad-faramosh ka mu'ahida, aur Asma-e-Ilahi ke azkaar. Sirf maqsad aur khaaka.

blocks.p: 'Zikr mein aadmi Allah se qareeb hota hai,' Hazrat Bai'at ke dars mein farmate hain; 'Allah ko yaad karta hai, aur khayal Allah ki taraf laga rehta hai.' Woh yeh bhi khabardaar karte hain ke saari raat qawwali sun lena akela kaafi nahin.

Part 3 mein Hazrat sikhaate hain ke jo amal Allah ke hukm ke tehet kiya jaaye woh Qurb-e-Faraiz, yaani faraaiz ke zariye qurb, mein daakhil hota hai. Isliye amal se pehle woh aayat yaad karo jis mein uska hukm hai.

blocks.q: Jab hum Kalime ka zikr, La ilaha illa Allah, karna chahte hain to pehle Fa'lam annahu la ilaha illa Allah padhte hain: jaan lo ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahin.

blocks.p: Isi tarah durood shareef se pehle woh aayat Innallaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'ala-n-Nabi padhte hain, kyunke us mein hukm hai: 'Ae imaan waalo, un par durood bhejo.'

Hazrat ek mu'ahide ka zikr karte hain jo saathiyon mein kiya jaata tha taaki Allah ki yaad kabhi na toote. Woh saath baithte, baat karte aur kaam karte; ek 'Allah!' pukaarta. Jiska dil haazir hota woh 'Alhamdulillah' kehta; jo ghaafil ho gaya hota woh 'Astaghfirullah' kehta.

blocks.q: Is yaad-faramosh ke mu'ahide se na sirf dawaam-e-huzoor ko madad milti hai, balke apni ghalati ka i'tiraaf karna padta hai. Tumhara kaam lillah fillah ho jaata hai.

blocks.p: Part 9 mein kitaab aise azkaar ka naam leti hai jo khayal ko jamaane mein madad karte hain: Ya 'Aleemu, Ya Khabeeru, Ya Samee'u, Ya Baseeru. Har ek ke saath tawajjoh ek jagah ki taraf ki jaati hai, aur har ek ka ek maqsad bataaya gaya hai: Ya 'Aleemu umm-ud-dimagh ki taraf, 'ilm ka markaz'; Ya Khabeeru dil ki taraf, 'taaki tum baakhabar ho jao'; Ya Samee'u kaanon ki taraf, taaki sunne ki taaqat mazboot ho; Ya Baseeru aankhon ki taraf, 'tum woh dekhoge jo ab tak nahin dekha'.

Hazrat batate hain ke Yakutpura ke raaste par cycle chalaate hue yeh Asma padhte padhte unke saamne 'aalam-e-misaal khul gaya. Woh yeh bhi farmate hain ke logon ke khayalaat se waaqif ho jaana aur door ki cheezein dekhna 'adna darje ki baatein' hain.

blocks.h: Aapka hissa aur Allah ka hissa

blocks.q: Tumhara kaam sirf padhna hai. Usko asar dena, usko poora karna, Allah ka kaam hai. Tum apna kaam karo.

blocks.note: Part 6 se 9 abhi YouTube par public nahin hain, isliye in hisson ka video link abhi nahin hai. Is mazmoon mein in azkaar ki ginti, waqt ya tareeqa nahin diya gaya: apne ustaad se poochiye.
Yeh amal karne se pehle apne ustaad/shaykh se seekhiye.
